g12-warehouse.brief: TECHNO: near-black warehouse, one industrial light bar slams to new stations on kicks (constant lit-edge budget = photosafe); buildup = light starving; drop = strobe-walk <=2/s.

g12-blackout.brief: TECHNO: near-black; kick = one small white figure flash (<=2/s, <20% area) leaving decaying outline afterimages; drop = parity-alternating pulse-fills (luminance-constant).

g12-scanline.brief: TECHNO: seismograph scanline sweeps a black field drawing the spectrum as terrain (<=8 phosphor traces); kick = staircase fracture; drop = 4 counter-sweeping lines; section = axis rotate.

g12-strobe-column.brief: TECHNO: gray colonnade, beat-sequenced pair-inversions (luminance-paired = photosafe strobe feel); kick = colonnade strides one column; drop = region-partitioned double-time + accent flood.

eloSemantics: v2: forced-choice only moves rating (K=32/400); both_good/both_bad are approval/rejection labels; both_bad kills winless candidates
scoring: v3: score = (wins + approvals) - (losses + rejections); approvals/rejections include solo likes/dislikes; elo rating retained as legacy tiebreaker
